applies_to: RHOSS chiller, heat pump and multipurpose unit plants run by the KMTM sequencer (KMTM/SI standard or KMTM/TI touch interface), up to 10 units.
summary: KMTM is RHOSS's plant sequencer for several chillers, heat pumps or multipurpose units on one primary loop, with an optional recovery branch. BACnet comes from a KBM card (BACnet MS/TP) or a KBE / KWEBU1 card (BACnet IP) fitted to the sequencer's pCO controller. The list has plant objects (on/off, season, setpoints, power limit, alarms), sequencer settings, and a block of read-only status, temperature and pressure objects for each unit (Unit 1 to Unit 8 for most blocks; some blocks run to Unit 10).
notes: Analog objects are scaled: units printed as °C/10, bar/10 or %/10 mean the value is in tenths (215 = 21.5 °C).
Multistate data is carried in AV objects that hold an enumerated value; the state texts are given in states.
Per-unit objects are printed for each unit (Unit 1, Unit 2 ...); the unit number is in the description, and the object name repeats with an index.
Rows printed as 'Not used' or 'Reserved' with no object name are left out (BV 11, BV 309, AV 12).
The alarm code objects use a table of about 600 codes printed at the end of the document; it is not copied here.
The guide covers the MTM communication table; see RHOSS manual H58701 for sequencer settings.
In the English table the units / values column for AV 315-322 is printed one row off; the units and states here follow the object descriptions.

integration.summary: Start and stop the plant with Superv_OnOff (BV 3), pick the season with Cool_Heat_KeyB (BV 4) and write the cooling and heating setpoints (AV 13 / AV 15). Enable supervisor on/off with En_SPV_OnOff (BV 310). Read plant status and the active setpoint, and watch Any_Alarm (BV 5). An optional power limit is set with Power_Request_Limit (AV 11).

integration.enable: BV 3 Superv_OnOff switches the plant on or off from the supervisor; En_SPV_OnOff (BV 310) enables on/off from the supervisor. See RHOSS manual H58701 for sequencer settings.
integration.heartbeat: Spv_Offline_Delay (AV 319, seconds) sets how long before the supervisor counts as disconnected, and Spv_Offline_Action (AV 318) picks what the plant does then: 1 = Off, 2 = On, 3 = None.
setup: KBM (BACnet MS/TP) factory values per RHOSS KBM/KBE manual H58230_C: device instance 77000, MAC 0, 38400 baud, Max Master 127, Max Info Frames 20; change them with the Carel BACset tool.
Per the same manual, on the KMTM set Support > Config. BMS (screen Hg02, installer password) to protocol MODBUS EXT, 19200 baud, address 1, no parity, 2 stop bits.
The KBM or KBE / KWEBU1 card is fitted to the sequencer's pCO5 / pCO5+ controller.
gotchas: Values are in tenths: divide °C/10, bar/10 and %/10 objects by 10.
Setpoint limits (AV 19-26) are writable settings that bound the setpoints; they are not the setpoints.
